verses.en: This day a general council of twenty-four high priests assembled at the house of Joseph Smith, Jun., by revelation, and proceeded to organize the high council of the church of Christ, which was to consist of twelve high priests, and one or three presidents as the case might require.
verses.sm: O Le aso nei na potopoto ai se aufono aoao o faitaulaga sili e toaluasefulufa i le fale o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, e ala i le faaaliga, ma aga e faatulaga le aufono maualuga o le Ekalesia a Keriso, lea e tatau ona i ai ni faitaulaga sili e toasefululua, ma se toatasi po o le toatolu o peresitene e pei atonu e manaomia ai mo le mataupu.

verses.en: The high council was appointed by revelation for the purpose of settling important difficulties which might arise in the church, which could not be settled by the church or the bishop’s council to the satisfaction of the parties.
verses.sm: Sa tofia le aufono maualuga i le faaaliga mo le faamoemoe o le foiaina o faafitauli taua atonu e tulai mai i le ekalesia, ia e lē mafai ona foia e le ekalesia po o le aufono a le epikopo i le lotomalilie o vaega uma.

verses.en: Joseph Smith, Jun., Sidney Rigdon and Frederick G. Williams were acknowledged presidents by the voice of the council; and Joseph Smith, Sen., John Smith, Joseph Coe, John Johnson, Martin Harris, John S. Carter, Jared Carter, Oliver Cowdery, Samuel H. Smith, Orson Hyde, Sylvester Smith, and Luke Johnson, high priests, were chosen to be a standing council for the church, by the unanimous voice of the council.
verses.sm: Sa talia Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, Sini Rikitone ma Feterika G. Viliamu o peresitene i le leo o le aufono; ma o Iosefa Samita, Matua, Ioane Samita, Iosefa Kou, Ioane Ioanesone, Matini Harisi, Ioane S. Kata, Iareto Kata, Oliva Kaotui, Samuel H. Samita, Orson Hyde, Sylvester Samita, ma Luka Ioanesone, o faitaulaga sili, sa filifilia e avea o se aufono tumau mo le ekalesia, i le leo autasi o le aufono.

verses.en: The above-named councilors were then asked whether they accepted their appointments, and whether they would act in that office according to the law of heaven, to which they all answered that they accepted their appointments, and would fill their offices according to the grace of God bestowed upon them.
verses.sm: Ona fesiligia lea o ia fautua ua ta’ua i luga pe latou te taliaina o latou tofiga, ma pe o le a latou galulue i lena tofiga e tusa ma le tulafono a le lagi, lea sa latou tali atu uma i ai ua latou talia o latou tofiga, ma o le a faia o latou tofi e tusa ma le alofa tunoa o le Atua ua faaee mai i luga o i latou.

verses.en: The number composing the council, who voted in the name and for the church in appointing the above-named councilors were forty-three, as follows: nine high priests, seventeen elders, four priests, and thirteen members.
verses.sm: O le aofai na aofia i le aufono, o e na palota i le igoa ma mo le ekalesia i le tofiaina o fautua ua ta’ua i luga e toafasefulu-tolu, e pei ona sosoo ai: toaiva faitaulaga sili, toasefulufitu toeaina, toafa ositaulaga, ma tagata o le ekalesia e toasefulutolu.

verses.en: Voted: that the high council cannot have power to act without seven of the above-named councilors, or their regularly appointed successors are present.
verses.sm: Palotaina: e lē mafai e le aufono maualuga ona maua se pule e fai ai se mea e aunoa ma se toafitu o fautua ua ta’ua i luga, po o le auai o ni o latou sui tofia tatau ai.

verses.en: These seven shall have power to appoint other high priests, whom they may consider worthy and capable to act in the place of absent councilors.
verses.sm: Ua i ai i lenei toafitu le pule e tofia ai isi faitaulaga sili, o e ua latou manatu ua agavaa ma agatonu e galue i le tulaga o fautua ua lē auai.

verses.en: Voted: that whenever any vacancy shall occur by the death, removal from office for transgression, or removal from the bounds of this church government, of any one of the above-named councilors, it shall be filled by the nomination of the president or presidents, and sanctioned by the voice of a general council of high priests, convened for that purpose, to act in the name of the church.
verses.sm: Palotaina: soo se taimi e tupu mai ai se avanoa i le maliu, aveesea mai le tofi ona o le solitulafono, po o le alu ese atu mai tuaoi o le pulega lenei o le ekalesia, o soo se tasi o fautua ua ta’ua i luga, ia faatumuina i le filifiliga a le peresitene po o peresitene, ma faamaonia i le leo o le aufono aoao o faitaulaga sili, e potopoto mo lena faamoemoe, e galulue i le igoa o le ekalesia.

verses.en: The president of the church, who is also the president of the council, is appointed by revelation, and acknowledged in his administration by the voice of the church.
verses.sm: O le peresitene o le ekalesia, o lē o le peresitene foi o le aufono, e tofia i le faaaliga, ma lagolagoina i lana pulega i le leo o le ekalesia.

verses.en: And it is according to the dignity of his office that he should preside over the council of the church; and it is his privilege to be assisted by two other presidents, appointed after the same manner that he himself was appointed.
verses.sm: Ma ua tusa ai ma le mamalu o lona tofi le tatau ai ona pulefaamalumalu o ia i luga o le aufono a le ekalesia; ma o lana aiā tatau le fesoasoani ia te ia o ni isi peresitene e toalua, e tofia i le ala e tasi na tofia ai o ia.

verses.en: And in case of the absence of one or both of those who are appointed to assist him, he has power to preside over the council without an assistant; and in case he himself is absent, the other presidents have power to preside in his stead, both or either of them.
verses.sm: Ma i le tulaga o le toesea o se toatasi po o i laua uma o e ua tofia e fesoasoani ia te ia, ua i ai ia te ia le pule e pulefaamalumalu ai i luga o le aufono e aunoa ma se fesoasoani; ma i le tulaga e toesea ai o ia lava, ua i ai i isi peresitene le pule e pulefaamalumalu ai i lona tulaga, i laua uma po o soo se tasi o i laua.

verses.en: Whenever a high council of the church of Christ is regularly organized, according to the foregoing pattern, it shall be the duty of the twelve councilors to cast lots by numbers, and thereby ascertain who of the twelve shall speak first, commencing with number one and so in succession to number twelve.
verses.sm: Soo se taimi e faatulaga tatau ai se aufono maualuga o le Ekalesia a Keriso, e tusa ma le ata ua mavae atu nei, o le tiute o fautua e toasefululua le faia o se vili i fuainumera, ma iloa ai i lena mea po o ai o le toasefululua e saunoa muamua, e amata mai le numera tasi ma faasolo atu ai faapena i le numera e sefululua.

verses.en: Whenever this council convenes to act upon any case, the twelve councilors shall consider whether it is a difficult one or not; if it is not, two only of the councilors shall speak upon it, according to the form above written.
verses.sm: Soo se taimi e potopoto ai lenei aufono e soalaupule soo se mataupu, e iloilo e fautua e toasefululua pe o se mataupu faigata pe leai; afai e lē faigata, nao le toalua fautua e saunoa i ai, e tusa ma le ala ua tusia i luga.

verses.en: But if it is thought to be difficult, four shall be appointed; and if more difficult, six; but in no case shall more than six be appointed to speak.
verses.sm: Ae afai e manatu ua faigata, ia tofia se toafa; ma afai ua sili atu ona faigata, e toaono; ae e leai se tulaga ia sili atu ai i le ono e e tofia e saunoa.

verses.en: The accused, in all cases, has a right to one-half of the council, to prevent insult or injustice.
verses.sm: O lē ua molia, i mataupu uma lava, ua i ai se aiā i le afa o le aufono, e puipuia ai mai le faalumaina po o le faamasinoletonu.

verses.en: And the councilors appointed to speak before the council are to present the case, after the evidence is examined, in its true light before the council; and every man is to speak according to equity and justice.
verses.sm: Ma o fautua ua tofia e saunoa i luma o le aufono e tuuina atu le mataupu, pe a uma ona iloiloina faamaoniga, i lona malamalama moni i luma o le aufono; ma ia saunoa tagata taitoatasi e tusa ma le lē faaituau ma le faamasinotonu.

verses.en: Those councilors who draw even numbers, that is, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, and 12, are the individuals who are to stand up in behalf of the accused, and prevent insult and injustice.
verses.sm: O fautua o e na seia numera soagia, o lona uiga, o le 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, ma le 12, o tagata ia o e ia tutu atu mo lē ua molia, ma puipui mai ai i le faalumaina ma le faamasinoletonu.

verses.en: In all cases the accuser and the accused shall have a privilege of speaking for themselves before the council, after the evidences are heard and the councilors who are appointed to speak on the case have finished their remarks.
verses.sm: I mataupu uma lava, ia maua e lē ua tagi ma lē ua molia se avanoa e saunoa ai mo i laua lava i luma o le aufono, pe a uma ona fofogaina o faamaoniga ma pe a uma saunoaga a fautua o e na tofia e saunoa i le mataupu.

verses.en: After the evidences are heard, the councilors, accuser and accused have spoken, the president shall give a decision according to the understanding which he shall have of the case, and call upon the twelve councilors to sanction the same by their vote.
verses.sm: A uma ona fofogaina o faamaoniga, ma saunoa fautua, ma lē ua tagi ma lē ua molia, ona tuu atu lea e le peresitene se faaiuga e tusa ma le malamalamaaga ua ia te ia e uiga i le mataupu, ma talosaga atu i fautua e toasefululua e faamaonia lea faaiuga e tasi i lo latou siilima.

verses.en: But should the remaining councilors, who have not spoken, or any one of them, after hearing the evidences and pleadings impartially, discover an error in the decision of the president, they can manifest it, and the case shall have a re-hearing.
verses.sm: Ae a iloa e le vaega o fautua o totoe, o e sa lei saunoa, po o soo se tasi o i latou, se sese i le faaiuga a le peresitene, ina ua uma ona faalogo ma le lē faailoga tagata i faamaoniga ma aioiga, e mafai ona latou faaali mai lena sese, ma ia toe faia ai se iloiloga.

verses.en: And if, after a careful re-hearing, any additional light is shown upon the case, the decision shall be altered accordingly.
verses.sm: Ma afai, e faaalia se malamalama faaopoopo e uiga i le mataupu, ina ua mavae le toe iloiloga toto’a ma le faaeteete, ia suia le faaiuga e faatatau i ai.

verses.en: But in case no additional light is given, the first decision shall stand, the majority of the council having power to determine the same.
verses.sm: Ae i le tulaga e leai ai se malamalama faaopoopo e tuuina mai, e tumau le faaiuga muamua, ma ua i ai i le toatele o le aufono le pule e fai ai lena lava faaiuga.

verses.en: In case of difficulty respecting doctrine or principle, if there is not a sufficiency written to make the case clear to the minds of the council, the president may inquire and obtain the mind of the Lord by revelation.
verses.sm: I le tulaga o se faigata e faatatau i se aoaoga faavae po o se mataupu autu, afai ua lē lava mea ua tusia e faamanino ai le mataupu i mafaufau o le aufono, e mafai e le peresitene ona ole atu ma maua le mafaufau o le Alii e ala i le faaaliga.

verses.en: The high priests, when abroad, have power to call and organize a council after the manner of the foregoing, to settle difficulties, when the parties or either of them shall request it.
verses.sm: Ua i ai i faitaulaga sili, pe a i ai i fafo, le pule e talo ma faatulaga ai se aufono e tusa ma le ala ua mavae ona ta’ua nei, e fo’ia ai faafitauli, pe a talosagaina e ni vaega po o soo se tasi o i latou.

verses.en: And the said council of high priests shall have power to appoint one of their own number to preside over such council for the time being.
verses.sm: Ma ua i ai i lea aufono o faitaulaga sili ua ta’ua le pule e tofia ai se tasi o i latou e pulefaamalumalu i se aufono faapena mo lena taimi.

verses.en: It shall be the duty of said council to transmit, immediately, a copy of their proceedings, with a full statement of the testimony accompanying their decision, to the high council of the seat of the First Presidency of the Church.
verses.sm: Ia avea ma tiute o le aufono ua ta’ua le auina atu, i le taimi lava lea, se kopi o a latou taualumaga, ma se faamatalaga atoa o le molimau e o faatasi ma la latou faaiuga, i le aufono maualuga i le nofoaga tutotonu o le Au Peresitene Sili o le Ekalesia.

verses.en: Should the parties or either of them be dissatisfied with the decision of said council, they may appeal to the high council of the seat of the First Presidency of the Church, and have a re-hearing, which case shall there be conducted, according to the former pattern written, as though no such decision had been made.
verses.sm: Afai e lē malilie vaega po o se tasi o i latou i le faaiuga a le aufono ua ta’ua, e mafai e i latou ona apili atu i le aufono maualuga o le nofoa o le Au Peresitene Sili o le Ekalesia, ma maua se toe iloiloga, ma o lea mataupu ia faia, e tusa ma le ala muamua ua tusia, e faapei e leai lava se faaiuga na faia.

verses.en: This council of high priests abroad is only to be called on the most difficult cases of church matters; and no common or ordinary case is to be sufficient to call such council.
verses.sm: O lenei aufono o faitaulaga sili e i fafo, ia nao tulaga silisili ona faigata o mataupu tau i le ekalesia e talo ai; ma ua leai se mataupu masani pe taatele ua alagatatau ai ona talo se aufono faapena.

verses.en: The traveling or located high priests abroad have power to say whether it is necessary to call such a council or not.
verses.sm: Ua i ai i faitaulaga sili femalagaai po ua nonofo i fafo le pule e fai mai ai pe ua tatau ona talo se aufono faapena pe leai.

verses.en: There is a distinction between the high council or traveling high priests abroad, and the traveling high council composed of the twelve apostles, in their decisions.
verses.sm: Ua i ai se eseesega i le va o le aufono maualuga po o faitaulaga sili femalagaai i fafo, ma le ’aufono maualuga femalagaai ua i ai aposetolo e toasefululua, ia latou faaiuga.

verses.en: From the decision of the former there can be an appeal; but from the decision of the latter there cannot.
verses.sm: O le faaiuga a le aufono muamua atu e mafai ona apili; ae o le faaiuga a le aufono mulimuli e lē mafai.

verses.en: The latter can only be called in question by the general authorities of the church in case of transgression.
verses.sm: Na’o pulega aoao o le ekalesia e mafai ona fesiligia faaiuga a le aufono mulimuli lea i le tulaga o le solitulafono.

verses.en: Resolved: that the president or presidents of the seat of the First Presidency of the Church shall have power to determine whether any such case, as may be appealed, is justly entitled to a re-hearing, after examining the appeal and the evidences and statements accompanying it.
verses.sm: Autasia: Ua i ai i le nofoa o le peresitene po o peresitene o le Au Peresitene Sili o le Ekalesia le pule e filifili ai pe ua agatonu tatau ai soo se mataupu faapena atonu e apili atu, mo se toe iloiloga, pe a uma lea ona suesueina o le apili ma faamaoniga ma faamatalaga ua tuuina atu faatasi ma le apili.

verses.en: The twelve councilors then proceeded to cast lots or ballot, to ascertain who should speak first, and the following was the result, namely: 1, Oliver Cowdery; 2, Joseph Coe; 3, Samuel H. Smith; 4, Luke Johnson; 5, John S. Carter; 6, Sylvester Smith; 7, John Johnson; 8, Orson Hyde; 9, Jared Carter; 10, Joseph Smith, Sen.; 11, John Smith; 12, Martin Harris.After prayer the conference adjourned.
verses.sm: Ona aga atu lea o fautua e toasefululua i le vili po o le palota, e iloa ai po o ai e tatau ona saunoa muamua, ma o le iuga lenei, sa faapea: 1. Oliva Kaotui; 2. Iosefa Kou; 3. Samuel H. Samita; 4. Luka Ioanesone; 5. Ioane S. Kata; 6. Sylvester Samita; 7. Ioane Ioanesone; 8. Orson Hyde; 9. Iareto Kata; 10. Iosefa Samita, Matua; 11. Ioane Samita; 12. Matini Harisi.Ina ua uma le tatalo sa tuua le konafesi.
